workflow_sequence.description: User authenticates and the tactic-builder app loads; the existing useUser hook (or future auth context) populates React state with the current user's userId and roles from the /user/me endpoint. No new backend or data changes are required.
User navigates to the Search (List) page; the page header section renders the new UserBadge component in the top-right, displaying the user's name (userId) and primary role.

User opens a Tactic Detail / Create page; the existing TacticStickyHeader renders the same UserBadge component in its right-hand action area so the badge remains visible in the top-right of the tactic-builder interface without altering existing tactic actions.

instrumentation_events.description: Fired when the UserBadge component renders with valid user data, for observability into page-level adoption and role distribution.

data_points.description: Page where the badge is shown (search-list or tactic-detail)
Number of roles held by the user
Whether user data was available at render time

instrumentation_events.description: Fired when the UserBadge component is rendered but no user data is present, to detect auth/state initialization issues.

data_points.description: Page where the badge was rendered without user data

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Create a reusable UserBadge molecule in the shared UI package that displays a user icon, the user's name, and the user's primary role.
new_responsibilities.intent: Display is a frontend concern; centralizing the badge in packages/ui keeps the two tactic-builder pages consistent and testable.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Derive the displayed name from the existing User.userId field and the displayed role from the first entry in User.roles, with fallbacks for missing data.
new_responsibilities.intent: The current User model exposes userId (email) and roles; no backend contract change is needed for this read-only display.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Integrate UserBadge into the Search (List) page header and the TacticStickyHeader right action area so it appears in the top-right of tactic-builder pages only.
new_responsibilities.intent: Placement is scoped to the tactic-builder interface per the story's tech note; both existing headers need a top-right anchor.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Implement responsive, overflow-safe styling (max-width, truncation, title attribute) for long userIds and role names.
new_responsibilities.intent: Handles the long-name and long-role edge cases without breaking the header layout.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Add appropriate ARIA labeling (aria-label describing 'Current user: {name}, role: {role}') and semantic markup for the badge.
new_responsibilities.intent: Accessibility is a frontend responsibility; the badge must be understandable to screen readers.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Follow ADR 20251205-15 (testId v2.0 component-centric pattern) by providing a UserBadge.testids.ts helper that appends element suffixes to a base testId.
new_responsibilities.intent: Keeps E2E tests stable and consistent with the repository's testId contract.

architectural_decisions.decision: Implement UserBadge as a shared UI package molecule rather than an inline component in each page.
architectural_decisions.justification: The badge is needed on both Search and Tactic Detail pages; a shared component ensures consistent styling, testIds, and accessibility behavior across the tactic-builder interface.
architectural_decisions.basis: Pattern precedent: StatusBadge is a shared molecule used by multiple pages and TacticStickyHeader; ADR 20251205-15 encourages reusable shared components with component-centric testIds.
architectural_decisions.impact: New component under src/ui/packages/ui/src/components/molecules/UserBadge; exported from packages/ui index.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: What icon library or design system should be used? -> Use the existing project Icons atom with a new User glyph.

architectural_decisions.decision: Use the existing useUser hook (and underlying /user/me API) as the badge's data source; make no backend or database changes.
architectural_decisions.justification: The story's tech note states user data is already available from the authentication/authorization flow; introducing new endpoints or schema fields would be scope creep.
architectural_decisions.basis: Explicit constraint from story.md tech note and current-reality.audit.json code audit entries for use-user.ts and user-api.ts.
architectural_decisions.impact: UserBadge receives user via props from parent components that call useUser(); no API contract changes.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: What should happen if user data is not available? -> Badge renders nothing (null) because the user is not authenticated/initialized; this is a frontend fallback only.

architectural_decisions.decision: Display userId as the user's name and the first role in User.roles as the displayed role, with a 'No Role' fallback when roles are empty.
architectural_decisions.justification: The current User model exposes userId (email) and roles; this satisfies the AC 'see my name and role' without requiring a displayName field or role display-name mapping service.
architectural_decisions.basis: Current User model in src/ui/packages/models/src/user.model.ts; user-api.ts and use-user.ts return this shape.
architectural_decisions.impact: UserBadge derives display values locally; future stories can extend the User model with displayName without breaking the badge.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: What is the exact format for displaying the role name? -> Show the raw role string as returned by the API (e.g., 'ProofReader').

architectural_decisions.decision: Make the badge read-only and non-interactive in this iteration.
architectural_decisions.justification: The story only asks to display name and role; adding a profile/logout menu would introduce new navigation flows and accessibility requirements not requested.
architectural_decisions.basis: Story acceptance criteria and tech note focus only on visibility, not interactivity.
architectural_decisions.impact: UserBadge renders as a static container with no click handlers or dropdown menu.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Should the badge be clickable/interactive? -> No; it is read-only for this story.

architectural_decisions.decision: Add a User icon to the existing Icons atom instead of importing directly from lucide-react.
architectural_decisions.justification: Keeps icon usage consistent with the rest of the tactic-builder UI, supports the existing size and testId props, and avoids mixing icon sources.
architectural_decisions.basis: Pattern precedent in src/ui/packages/ui/src/components/atoms/Icons/Icons.tsx which already wraps all icons in a BaseIcon component.
architectural_decisions.impact: New Icons.User glyph added to the Icons namespace; UserBadge uses <Icons.User size='sm' />.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: What icon library or design system should be used? -> Existing project Icons atom.

architectural_decisions.decision: Integrate UserBadge into existing page headers rather than introducing a new global app shell/layout.
architectural_decisions.justification: The tactic-builder currently has two distinct header surfaces (List page header and TacticStickyHeader). A minimal, surgical change places the badge top-right on both without refactoring the application's routing/layout structure.
architectural_decisions.impact: List.tsx header section and TacticStickyHeader.tsx right action area each render <UserBadge /> when appropriate.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: N/A - placement decision based on current header architecture

questions_addressed.question: What is the exact format for displaying the role name? Should it be the role's display name or system identifier?
questions_addressed.answer: Display the raw role string returned by the API (e.g., 'ProofReader', 'Requester'). No role-to-display-name mapping is introduced.
questions_addressed.justification: The User model currently stores role identifiers, and there is no existing role-display-name dictionary in the frontend. This keeps the change minimal and avoids inventing localized labels.
questions_addressed.basis: Current User model and useUser implementation in src/ui/packages/models/src/user.model.ts and src/ui/apps/tactic-builder/src/shared/hooks/use-user.ts.

questions_addressed.question: Should the badge be clickable/interactive (e.g., to open user profile or logout menu)?
questions_addressed.answer: No. The badge is read-only in this iteration.
questions_addressed.justification: The story's acceptance criteria only require visibility of name and role; adding interactivity would expand scope into profile/logout flows and their associated accessibility requirements.
questions_addressed.basis: Story.md acceptance criteria and tech note.

questions_addressed.question: What should happen if user data is not available in the application state?
questions_addressed.answer: UserBadge renders nothing (returns null). Because the user must be authenticated to reach tactic-builder pages, an undefined user indicates an initialization state and should not leave a broken UI element.
questions_addressed.justification: A null render is the safest fallback for a read-only display component when its required data is missing; it avoids showing 'Unknown User' or placeholder text that could confuse users.
questions_addressed.basis: Defensive UI pattern consistent with existing conditional rendering in List.tsx (e.g., RequesterFilter only shown when user has the role).

questions_addressed.question: Should the badge update in real-time if the user's role changes during their session?
questions_addressed.answer: The badge reflects the user state at component mount because useUser fetches /user/me once on mount. Real-time role-change updates are not required for this story.
questions_addressed.justification: Role changes during an active session are a rare admin operation; refreshing the page (or future auth-context re-fetch) will pick up changes. Adding real-time updates is out of scope.
questions_addressed.basis: Current useUser implementation loads user data in a useEffect with an empty dependency array.

questions_addressed.question: Are there any accessibility requirements for the badge (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation)?
questions_addressed.answer: UserBadge uses an aria-label describing the current user and role (e.g., 'Current user: de.mo@purina.com, role: Requester'). It is a static display, so no keyboard navigation is needed.
questions_addressed.justification: A static read-only component does not require focus management, but screen-reader users must understand what the badge conveys.
questions_addressed.basis: WCAG 2.2 AA informative/non-interactive content guidance; repository accessibility-core rule.

questions_addressed.question: What icon library or design system should be used for the user icon?
questions_addressed.answer: Add a new User glyph to the existing project Icons atom and consume it via <Icons.User />.
questions_addressed.justification: This preserves the existing icon conventions (BaseIcon sizing, testId support, aria-hidden) and avoids mixing icon sources.
